scripts.build:css: node scripts/generate-tailwind-safelist.mjs && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i styles/tailwind.css -o public/app.css --minify
scripts.predev: npm run prepare:static && npm run build:css
scripts.prebuild: npm run prepare:static && npm run build:css
scripts.prebuild:ios: npm run prepare:static && npm run build:css
scripts.build:ios: vite build --mode ios && node scripts/seal-release.mjs && cap sync ios
